$comment: Shimla ke asli landmarks, asli coordinates ke saath. Missions, fast-travel, aur minimap markers inhi pe lagte hain.

pois.name: The Ridge
pois.desc: Shimla ka dil. Khula maidan, sheher ka sabse bada gathering point.

pois.name: Christ Church
pois.desc: 1857. Neo-Gothic. Raat mein iski stained glass jagmagati hai.

pois.name: Scandal Point
pois.desc: Mall aur Ridge ka junction. Yahin sab milte hain, yahin sab baat phailti hai.

pois.name: Gaiety Theatre
pois.desc: 1887 ka Victorian theatre.

pois.name: Town Hall
pois.desc: Shimla Municipal Corporation.

pois.name: Jakhoo Mandir
pois.desc: 2455 m. 108-ft Hanuman murti. Bandaron se chashma bacha ke rakhna.

pois.name: Lakkar Bazaar
pois.desc: Lakdi ke khilone aur saaman. Nafisa ka office isi ke upar hai.

pois.name: Shimla Railway Station
pois.desc: Kalka-Shimla narrow gauge ka terminus. 96 km, 102 tunnel, 864 pul. UNESCO World Heritage.

pois.name: ISBT Tutikandi
pois.desc: HRTC ka adda. Guru yahin milta hai.

pois.name: Viceregal Lodge
pois.desc: 1888 ka Rashtrapati Niwas. 1945 ki Shimla Conference yahin hui thi.

pois.name: Himachal Pradesh University
pois.desc: Summer Hill campus.

pois.name: Annandale Ground
pois.desc: Shimla ka ek maatra samtal maidan. Army helipad aur cricket ground.

pois.name: HP Vidhan Sabha
pois.desc: Himachal Pradesh Vidhan Sabha.

pois.name: Ellerslie Secretariat
pois.desc: HP Secretariat. Yahin se saare tender pass hote hain.

pois.name: Sanjauli Tunnel
pois.desc: 1850s ka tunnel. Ridge aur Sanjauli ke beech ka rasta.

pois.name: Thakur Motor Works
pois.desc: Vicky ke baap ki garage. Kahani yahin se shuru hoti hai.

pois.name: Vicky ka ghar
pois.desc: Sanjauli ki dhalan pe teen-manzila. Amma upar rehti hai. Yahan save karo.

pois.name: Nafisa ka daftar
pois.desc: 'Pahari Awaaz' newspaper ka ek-kamre ka daftar.

pois.name: Hotel Deodar Palace
pois.desc: Rana Sahab ka flagship hotel, Mall Road pe. Uska darbar.

pois.name: Bali Construction Yard
pois.desc: Contractor Bali ka yard. Cement, sariya, aur bahut saara illegal timber.

pois.name: Dhalli Timber Depot
pois.desc: Sarkari depot - kaagaz pe. Raat mein kuch aur hi chalta hai.

pois.name: Police Headquarters
pois.desc: DSP Ahluwalia ka office.

pois.name: Sanjauli Chowk
pois.desc: Sanjauli ka bheed-bhaad wala chauraha.

pois.name: Chhota Shimla Bazaar
pois.desc: Sarkari quarters ke beech ka bazaar. Sabzi, chai, aur sarkari gossip.

pois.name: Kasumpti Market
pois.desc: Sabzi mandi aur chhoti dukanein.

pois.name: New Shimla Loop
pois.desc: Chaudi planned sadkein. Street race ka adda.

pois.name: Catchment Forest Gate
pois.desc: Sanctuary ka barrier. Raat ko timber truck yahin se nikalte hain.

pois.name: Bishop Cotton School
pois.desc: 1859. 'Eton of the East'.

pois.name: Auckland House
pois.desc: Purana colonial school.

pois.name: Prospect Hill
pois.desc: Kamna Devi mandir. Pure sheher ka view.

pois.name: Guru ka Dhaba
pois.desc: ISBT ke peeche. Rajma-chawal aur getaway plan.

pois.name: Chhotu ka adda
pois.desc: Jakhoo ki chadhai pe ek tooti deodar. Yahan se poora Mall dikhta hai.
